_comment: Targets for the fleet's /secret skill (~/.claude/skills/secret/secret.sh) when it runs in this checkout. Added 2026-11-28 by piece 5 of the form checks (https://claude.ai/artifact/4UWXZQzkUhCvdCZ9Y9b4nR). It connects AS the account that owns the files, the way this site's deploy does (tools/prod-deploy-config.v2.json: offda9@72.167.54.213 with ~/.ssh/id_rsa_automation), so it writes its own files with no sudo and no chown. The OD9 bot's own config (OD9-Discord-Bot/.claude/secret-config.json) keeps its older targets into this tree, written through ultimaterage with sudo. This file never ships: the deploy excludes .claude/.

form-checks._why: The widget keys of offda9.com's human check (Cloudflare Turnstile). includes/od9_form_guard.php requires this file, when it exists, on every page that carries a guarded form, the popup on every page included; with no file the check is off. TURNSTILE_SITEKEY is the Bitwarden item's username and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY its password (item 'OD9 Turnstile offda9.com'). A *.config.php: git ignores it, the deploy never ships it and never deletes it, and config/ is refused at the origin (config/.htaccess). The writer makes the file opening with <?php and refuses one that does not open with it (secret.sh, 2026-11-28), because PHP would print it on every page.
